title: Resurrection
definition: The resurrection is the future raising of the dead, grounded in Christ’s bodily resurrection and promised to all people, with believers raised to life and unbelievers to judgment.
summary: The Bible teaches bodily resurrection, not merely the survival of the soul. Christ’s resurrection is the firstfruits and guarantee of the believer’s resurrection.
christFocus: Because Christ rose, those who belong to Him will also rise. The body matters, death is defeated, and eternal hope is secure in Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Christ’s resurrection guarantees the believer’s resurrection.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Resurrection leads either to life in Christ or judgment apart from Him.
